features.title: Etch and trace
features.text: Runesmiths draw magic runes on creatures and equipment. Etched runes last until spent or removed, while traced runes fade at the end of the next turn.

features.title: Invoke Rune
features.text: Runes grant ongoing effects. Invoking a rune releases its power and consumes it, so the choice is whether to keep its benefit or spend it.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3.5 → 3–4.5. Damage runes and invocation combinations can emphasize offense; supportive runes invest elsewhere.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3–4. Armor, shields and protective rune selections influence personal durability.
ratings.support: 4 → 3–4.5. Beneficial runes and debuffs offer several ways to enhance allies.
ratings.utility: 3.5 → 3–4. Crafting and selected runes provide useful but specialized exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Track etched and traced runes, duration, placement and invocation timing.
